The climate around the major cities is four-season continental with cold and snowy winters combined with warm to hot humid summers , but further north long winter seasons dominate and as a result the northern areas of the province are marked by tundra conditions .	province	Provinces and territories of Canada	continental	humid continental climate	tundra	tundra
Even in central Quebec at comparatively southerly latitudes winters are severe in inland areas .
